difficulty_reason: For X -> T -> S with T -> S flat locally of finite presentation and X -> T locally of finite type, a complex E is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S iff relative to T. The retained proof is written: choose locally on X a closed immersion i : X -> A^n_T (available since X -> T is locally of finite type); the composite A^n_T -> S is flat and locally of finite presentation (affine space preserves the property), so the chapter's composition law (lemma composition-relative-pseudo-coherent, card L16115) applies to the two-factor diagram X -> A^n_T -> S with the pseudo-coherence hypothesis on the middle structure sheaf verified from flatness, yielding exactly the claimed equivalence. Retained author proof at lines 20691-20697.
